title: Random Bug Walk records, schema version 1
description: Every pattern matches the whole string: it starts with ^ and ends with $, and both languages apply it as a full match.

SafeInteger.description: An integer whose absolute value is at most 2^53 - 1.

UtcTime.description: UTC RFC 3339 time ending in Z. The format adds the calendar check (no 2026-02-30, no second 60).

Slug.description: Lowercase words of letters and digits joined by single hyphens.

RelativePath.description: A relative POSIX path. Segments use letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', and never start with '.'.

HttpsRepositoryUrl.description: https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>: no userinfo, port, query, fragment, .git suffix or trailing slash.

HttpsBaseUri.description: An absolute https URL ending in '/', with no userinfo, port, query or fragment.

HttpsObjectUri.description: An absolute https URL of one object: no userinfo, port, query, fragment or trailing slash.

OmissionOutcome.description: Outcome of a manifest entry whose bytes are not published as staged.

FamilyRegistry.description: Family IDs, source fixes and mutation IDs are each unique across the registry (checked in code).

HeldOutIdentityList.description: Identities reserved for held-out use. Supplied at run time; private in real use.

RootRun.description: child_execution_ids never contains root_execution_id (checked in code).

ArtifactManifest.description: Entry keys are unique (checked in code).

PublicationRecord.description: execution_id is the root's own ID, and artifacts are sorted by path with unique paths (checked in code).

RunManifestEntry.description: redactions are sorted by category with one item per category, and a public_uri ends in sha256/<sha256>, or equals the policy's base URI plus that key when checked against the policy (checked in code).

RunManifest.description: executions list the root first with a null parent, then each child with the root as parent; entries are sorted by path with unique paths; withheld entries are withheld/1 to withheld/<k> without gaps (checked in code).

StagingOmissions.description: Private staging input, never published. Paths are unique across entries, and each (path, category) pair appears once in redactions (checked in code).

TrialReason.description: One list for invalid and incomplete trial results, and for observations that did not produce a pass or an assertion failure.

AssertionFailureCode.description: Codes of the first fixture; a later fixture adds values here.

CheckId.description: Lowercase slugs joined by dots, with at least one dot, such as tzarg.la-day-counts.

TestId.description: An opaque test-runner ID, such as a Playwright spec id: printable ASCII without spaces.

OperationKind.description: Lowercase words of letters, digits and '_' joined by dots, such as admission or writer.issue. Every JobKind value is one.

CallName.description: Segments of lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' joined by colons, such as writer.issue:cand-17:3.

FileMode.description: A regular file's git mode. Symlinks (120000) and submodules are not file modes here.

TimeZoneName.description: An IANA time zone name such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC. Only the shape is checked.

LocaleTag.description: A BCP 47 language tag such as en-US. Only the shape is checked.

EndpointPath.description: A public endpoint path: '/' followed by segments of letters, digits, '.', '_', '~' and '-' that never start with '.'; no query or fragment.

JobRequest.description: parent_execution_id is null exactly when execution_id equals root_execution_id and never equals execution_id; operation_id and payload_hash equal the values computed from the request's own fields (checked in code).

ExpectedTrial.description: expected_checks are unique by check_id (checked in code).

ExpectedTrials.description: Trial IDs are unique. Checked against its request, the manifest's SHA-256, execution_id and task_revision match the request, and the trials follow the request kind's profile (checked in code).

TrialObservations.description: observations are sorted by repeat_index, then check_id in code point order, and unique by that pair (checked in code).

TrialResult.description: Evidence that a trial ran, not a verdict. ended_at is not before started_at, and checked against its request the identity fields match the request (checked in code).

QueryParameters.description: Public query parameter names (ASCII letters, digits and '_') mapped to string values.

SymptomEvent.description: utc_instant is the UTC time of timestamp_seconds (checked in code).

ObservedSymptom.description: The only input the issue writer accepts. It allows no other field, so it holds no stack trace, source path, function name, test or assertion title, check ID, patch, SQL or repair suggestion.

OperationIdentity.description: Its SHA-256 is the operation_id. A job request uses its own fields with call_name null; a provider call uses its call kind and call name.

MutationChange.description: Hashes are SHA-256s of the full file bytes. An addition has a null original side and a deletion a null resulting side; never both. A change with the same hash and mode on both sides is refused (checked in code).

MutationIdentity.description: Its SHA-256 is the mutation_id. changes are sorted by path with unique paths (checked in code).

TaskRevisionIdentity.description: Its SHA-256 is the task_revision. It holds no price, rate sheet or execution profile.

ImageReference.description: A registry image pinned by its manifest digest: <repository>@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.

ReleaseRevision.description: The complete task revision and the identity it hashes.

ReleaseRun.description: The published root run and its PublicationRecord's IDs.

ReleaseAdmission.description: The admission job's verdict and ADM-08 classification. Only a passing admission with a demonstrated blind spot is released.

ReleaseApproval.description: The recorded human approval of the frozen issue (ADM-07). A rejection is no release.

ReleaseJudgeJob.description: The frozen judge job's index in the private store, by key and SHA-256.

Release.description: A released case (ADM-09). release_id is a UUID assigned before anything is built, never derived from content; release_sha256 is the SHA-256 of this record's canonical bytes. files lists the release directory's other files.
